findings.evidence: Line 48 `abbrev hyperbolicModel ... := (Module.Dual K (hyperbolicHalf K n) × hyperbolicHalf K n) × hyperbolicRemainder K n`; line 146 `theorem hyperbolicModelForm_nondegenerate ... (hyperbolicModelForm K n).Nondegenerate`.
findings.fix: Say "the uniform hyperbolic model form `hyperbolicModelForm`" in all three places, reserving "model" for the module `hyperbolicModel`.
findings.issue: "The uniform hyperbolic model is nondegenerate" — but `hyperbolicModel` is defined at line 48 as the *module* `(Module.Dual K _ × _) × _`, which cannot be nondegenerate; the theorem is about `hyperbolicModelForm`. Same conflation at line 57 ("The hyperbolic model is the evaluation pairing plus...", stating a value of `hyperbolicModelForm`) and line 20 ("the uniform hyperbolic model" for the form).

findings.evidence: Lines 52-55 build the form from `QuadraticForm.dualProd`; `mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Dual.lean:82` documents `dualProd` as "the quadratic form on `(f, x)` defined as `f x`" — Mathlib never calls it hyperbolic, and no lemma here bridges the two.
findings.fix: Describe the actual shape: "the dual-pairing form `QuadraticForm.dualProd` on `Module.Dual K (Fin (n / 2) → K) × (Fin (n / 2) → K)` — isometric to an orthogonal sum of `n / 2` hyperbolic planes — together with the standard `n % 2`-dimensional sum of squares."
findings.issue: "The product of `n / 2` hyperbolic planes" promises more than the definition delivers: the definition is a single `QuadraticForm.dualProd K (Fin (n / 2) → K)`, and the file never states or proves its identification with an n/2-fold product of planes. A reader expecting to rewrite with per-plane components finds no such API.

findings.evidence: Lines 17-20 list one entry; lines 47-55 and 138-151 define four further public declarations. PR description: "Provides: a reusable hyperbolic-model equivalence, its form equation, dimension, and nondegeneracy."
findings.fix: Add a `## Main definitions` section for `hyperbolicModel` / `hyperbolicModelForm`, list the finrank and nondegeneracy results under `## Main results`, and add a sentence on what this supplies and what it deliberately leaves to the representation-theory consumer, as the sibling `Standard.lean:19-21` does.
findings.issue: The module docstring lists only `hyperbolicDecomposition`, omitting the definitions and results downstream code must name: `hyperbolicModel`, `hyperbolicModelForm`, `finrank_hyperbolicModel`, `hyperbolicModelForm_nondegenerate` — the PR itself advertises these as the reusable surface. It also never says what consumes the file.

summary: Documentation is present on every public declaration and the Mathlib adaptation is credited correctly, but several docstrings call the quadratic form "the hyperbolic model" — a name the file already binds to the underlying module — and the model form's docstring advertises a product of hyperbolic planes without naming the `dualProd` it is actually built from. The module header also omits the definitions downstream consumers must name.
